purpose: Audit-first orchestration that detects, classifies, safely repairs mechanical defects, blocks unsafe scientific assumptions, and produces a terminal status.
promotion_rule: A scientific RESULT is allowed only if every required stage passes and the execution gate is explicitly open.

failure_semantics.INFRASTRUCTURE_FAILURE: execution environment or required infrastructure is unavailable
failure_semantics.IMPLEMENTATION_FAILURE: code or contract defect remains after safe mechanical repair attempts
failure_semantics.INPUT_FAILURE: required scientific input is missing, frozen provenance is absent, or data are invalid
failure_semantics.SCIENTIFIC_FAILURE: a registered scientific hypothesis is falsified under its pre-registered rule
failure_semantics.INCONCLUSIVE: execution is valid but evidence cannot decide the registered hypothesis
failure_semantics.RESULT: all validity gates pass and the pre-registered result rule is satisfied
